claims.text: When the owner records a voice memo for an article he says things as he remembers them, instinct ahead of evidence, and the agent that writes with him checks the repositories, commits, briefs, documentation, web and his own old writing.
claims.quote: I say it as I remember it. The agent checks it against the record before anyone reads it.

claims.text: In the last eight articles five of the owner's claims were confirmed, five corrected and two could not be found, and each article says which.
claims.quote: five claims confirmed, five corrected, two that could not be found

value.unit: memo claims corrected across eight articles

claims.text: For the sgit history article the agent found the vault and data room were named weeks before the features the owner remembered, that the move to Git's model took two weeks not one, eight months not nine, and a feature shipped in 22 minutes.
claims.quote: the first feature a paying user asked for went from proposal to code in 22 minutes

claims.text: Where the agent could not find something, such as usage figures or where the idea for the sandbox came from, it said so, and the recollection is marked as such.
claims.quote: Where it could not find something, such as usage figures or where the idea for the sandbox came from, it said so

claims.text: Cedar's place in the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, half-remembered, was right; the Lambda the owner thought served this site was wrong; the Chainguard list he thought he had seen does not exist.
claims.quote: the Lambda I thought served this site was wrong; the Chainguard list I thought I had seen does not exist

claims.text: The owner first noticed this with ChatGPT Deep Research, released by OpenAI in February 2025, an agent that generates cited reports by autonomously browsing the web, which he used for many essays on diniscruz.ai.
claims.quote: generates cited reports on a user-specified topic by autonomously browsing the web

claims.text: On 11 February 2025, eight days after the launch, an essay written with Deep Research on O2 Platform's MethodStreams had 69 links, 31 of them to three pages of the owner's own old blog, two posts from June 2012 and the O2 Platform page.
claims.quote: Of its 69 links, 31 point to three pages of my own old blog, two posts from June 2012 and the O2 Platform page.

value.unit: links to the owner's own 2012 posts

claims.text: On topics where little had been published, such as the early days of the owner's work on graphs, the evidence Deep Research found was often the owner himself, years before; the essay is signed By Dinis Cruz and ChatGPT Deep Research.
claims.quote: the evidence it found was often me, talking about it years before

claims.text: Peer review used to come afterwards from people on Twitter or LinkedIn; Cunningham's Law, named by Steven McGeady after Ward Cunningham, says post the wrong answer to get the right one, which works but is slow, public and corrects what has spread.
claims.quote: It works, but it is slow, public and noisy, and it corrects what has already spread.

claims.text: Now the first review happens before publishing, against the record rather than the crowd; it does not replace readers, it means what they read already has its evidence attached, every link, a section on what the article does not claim, and where it came from.
claims.quote: Now the first review happens before publishing, against the record rather than against the crowd.

claims.text: Thinking out loud used to drive the owner's teams mad as a plan moved from Monday to Friday; with this workflow the instinct can go first because the evidence catches up before anyone else has to act on it.
claims.quote: The memo is a draft of a thought; the article is the thought, checked.

claims.text: The checking goes both ways: the owner corrected the agent, which had written pioneers and settlers for Simon Wardley's stages, where the names to use now are explorers, villagers and town planners.
claims.quote: it had written pioneers and settlers for Simon Wardley's stages, and the names to use now are explorers, villagers and town planners

claims.text: The habit of recomputing everything caught a bug in the site's own tools: while building the tokens hook the agent found the session's status report had been counting each model response two or three times, and fixed it.
claims.quote: this session's own status report had been counting each model response two or three times, and fixed it

claims.text: The owner still reads and validates every article, and learns from the references the agent finds, often ones half-remembered from a book or a talk.
claims.quote: I still read and validate every article; if something in it is not right, I say so, and it changes.

claims.text: Much of what is written here should be rewritten by journalists and researchers with their own angle, given the body of work and its provenance; their agents should follow the links, check the claims and disagree where the evidence says so.
claims.quote: Their agents should do the same thing on the other side: follow the links, check the claims, and disagree where the evidence says so.

claims.text: It is a graph: every checked article is a node with edges to its sources and the articles before it, and the more is published this way the more the next claim can be checked against.
claims.quote: Every checked article is a node with edges to its sources, and to the articles before it.

claims.text: The agent can be wrong too: checking reduces errors, it does not remove them, which is why the owner still reviews.
claims.quote: Checking reduces errors; it does not remove them, which is why I still review.

claims.text: Not found is not false: it means the evidence was not found, and the article says so.
claims.quote: It means the evidence was not found, and the article says so.

claims.text: The tally is small: fourteen claims across eight articles, not a study.
claims.quote: Fourteen claims across eight articles, not a study.

claims.text: The Deep Research recollection is partly the owner's: the O2 essay and its links are checkable, but the wider memory of it finding his writing on graphs is not counted.
claims.quote: The O2 essay and its links are checkable; the wider memory of it finding my writing on graphs is not counted here.

claims.text: The article came from a voice memo on 15 October 2026 written by this site's agent; the ledger is from releases v0.12.53 to v0.12.62, and the O2 essay's links were counted on 15 October 2026.
claims.quote: The ledger is from this site's releases v0.12.53 to v0.12.62 and the articles they published.
